Overview

Namur is a city in Namur with a population of 111,000. The capital of Wallonia, perched at the confluence of the Meuse and Sambre rivers, with a magnificent citadel and charming old town. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
